description: the ALTER statement — an obsolete element of ANSI X3.23-1985, DELETED by ISO/IEC 1989:2002 (§2023:14.9.17; the 2023 standard has no ALTER and GO TO has no altered form). Folded from the inline COBOL0810 binder gate (P2.6b).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.17 (no altered GO TO); obsolete ’85 element (§1985:VI.6.7.2, REMOVED) deleted by ISO 2002
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMALT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
P1.
    GO TO P2.
P2.
    ALTER P1 TO PROCEED TO P2.
    STOP RUN.
